observed_trace_validation.scope: Observed candidate availability and target choice only; no measured alternate-policy speedup or source-content age
observed_trace_validation.continuity_scope: Successful projection submissions only; schema 1/2 does not record every render attempt. Target gaps establish only compatibility with intervening renders, not their count or outcome.
observed_trace_validation.warning: Higher frame ID or target is not proof of a newer application scene or physical display time

limitations: Application frame identity is not a simulation or input epoch.
Host monotonic callbacks are not photon or client clock times.
Accepted compositor input is not proof of encoded delivery.
Projection target matching does not establish layer ownership when targets coincide.
Trace adds atomic and clock-read overhead; do not use for promotion.

assumptions: Known source identity age is submit minus earliest recorded headset-local receipt among exact known encoded frames sharing the same canonical latched application set.
It is a separate diagnostic metric. Original encoded-frame receipt metrics and policy limits are unchanged.
All subtractions remain headset-local; host timestamps only establish identities and are never subtracted.
A later encoded frame carrying the same source identity cannot reset this known-source receipt origin.
The known source origin can omit earlier unobserved frames and therefore is not complete application/input age; shared source IDs also do not establish identical pixels.
Origin metadata may be identified later in hindsight; this is recorded explicitly and is not a runnable online selector.
First selected-source membership includes actual pre-warm selection history. It differs from first host latch or first known network receipt.
Any exact-phase winning paths are rescored only; their encoded-receipt optimality does not establish source-receipt optimality.
